title: NFL London Games Exclusive 2026 Topps Flagship Football
method: Fresh official browser article read and three expanded FAQ answers: exclusive parallels, regular-checklist equivalence and store on-sale wording. Factual summaries and exact program names, not raw HTML or an article reproduction. Retained candidate entries reconciled against current imported PDF rows and exact original odds captions.

facts.checklistScope: The guide and expanded checklist FAQ identify the same 400-card base checklist and rookie class as regular 2026 Flagship Football; London-specific content consists of five exclusive base parallels.
facts.distributionScope: London Store Exclusive Mega Box, sold only at the Fanatics Collectibles London Flagship Store on Regent Street.
facts.onSaleStatement: September 23, London store only, from the expanded release FAQ. The regular August 21 verified release is separate; no general release date is changed.
facts.serialScope: The expanded exclusive-parallels FAQ states Big Ben /59, Tudor Rose /5 and 1/1 Crown Jewels as base parallels. Union Jack Rainbow Foil and Union Jack Blue Rainbow Foil have no numbering claim.
facts.examples: The guide shows Tudor Rose on Ashton Jeanty Future Stars and AFC Pass Leaders and Crown Jewels on Carnell Tate. These examples do not establish limits for Chrome, inserts, autographs, relics or other parallels.

odds.repeatedCaptions: Original repeated captions and different printed ratios remain separate physical source rows; no single ratio is selected from them.
